reviews.comment: Don't get me wrong, Mr. Thompson has an old fashioned way of teaching, but you can tell he genuinely cares about his students. You are paying for the class, might as well stay off your phone and pay attention,  you will actually learn a lot. He offers a ton of extra credit which is nice!

Class designed to waste time. Professor will take points from final grade if you are tardy or absent regardless or reason. Will take points from final grade if wearing a hat(yes a hat). Will take points from final grade if caught using phone in a class you pay to go to.

Prof Thompson is a great guy who cares about his students. I took ENTR289 and it was an extremely easy class and he's very good at answering questions and explaining anything if you have questions. Easy A if youre not an idiot and pay attention in class

It is a difficult class, but the information is beneficial. A lot of the content is knowledge that you would use every day if you were serious about the major you chose. Don't mess around, follow his little nit-picky rules (Even if they don't make sense), and do your work on time. The people that diss him aren't ready for the real world.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: TAs were continually disruptive, talking in the back of the classroom throughout the course of every lecture. In regards to the professor, he made every homework assignment due at 11 PM on a Saturday. The lectures focused on how to perform Excel functions rather than focusing on course material. Be prepared to sit in class the scheduled two hours.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor doesn't realize that students have other things going on besides his class. Every class you miss you lose 3 points off your final grade. His slides in class are impossible to follow and not set up in a way where you can take good notes. Don't wear a hat or get on your phone in class because he will take points off your final grade.

Mr. Thompson was one of my favorite professors at TAMU. His course was not particularly easy, but it was not too bad either. I learned quite a bit in his course, and he truly cares about his students. He encourages students to ask questions throughout class, and is very helpful in office hours. You must work hard, but I highly recommend taking him.

Professor Thompson is a great lecturer but he has these two little minions that sit in the back of the class and are very strict. I wouldn't take this class again just because of his Teaching Assistants.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.
